tier: AWS Free Tier (on-demand EC2 and Lambda)
confidence_note: all numbers are quoted from the first-party CodeBuild pricing page and run-build docs; no build was run, so worker behaviour during a build, the price of data transfer, and what happens after the 100 monthly minutes are spent are unverified

free_tier.stated: 100 total build minutes per month with the general1.small or arm1.small instance types using on-demand Amazon EC2, and 6,000 total build seconds per month with the lambda.arm.1GB or lambda.x86-64.1GB compute types using on-demand Lambda; the free tier does not expire at the end of the 12-month AWS Free Tier term and is available to new and existing AWS customers
free_tier.notes: the headline counts build minutes on on-demand EC2; Lambda compute is metered in seconds under a separate 6,000-second allowance. Reserved Capacity EC2, Sandbox and Docker image server have no free tier. The unit counts minutes a build runs from submission to termination, not one unit per build

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the pricing and run-build pages read state no cap on a single build input or artifact

retention.stated: unverified: the pricing and run-build pages read state no retention period for build logs or artifacts

egress.terms: unverified: the pricing page states that builds may incur additional charges when they transfer data, but states no data-transfer allowance or rate

interface_detail: builds run from the AWS CodeBuild console, the AWS CLI or the AWS SDKs; build projects and triggers are managed through the AWS APIs
tooling: the AWS CodeBuild console, the AWS CLI and the AWS SDKs; the user supplies a buildspec.yml build definition and a source repository
chaining: a build runs to completion on an AWS-managed compute instance or on Lambda and its result is published to AWS services such as S3 and ECR; the console, CLI or an AWS SDK starts each build and each minute or second spends the monthly allowance. Reserved Capacity fleets are a separate paid offer outside this free allowance

limits.value: 100 free build minutes per month on on-demand EC2 general1.small or arm1.small; beyond it general1.small costs $0.005 per minute
6,000 free build seconds per month on on-demand Lambda lambda.arm.1GB or lambda.x86-64.1GB
on-demand EC2 build duration is rounded up to the nearest minute; Lambda duration is rounded up to the nearest second

limits_note: Reserved Capacity EC2 instances carry a minimum charge of 60 minutes each, and Mac reserved instances a minimum of 24 hours; Sandbox and Docker image server have no free tier
binding_note: the 100 monthly EC2 build-minutes are spent from submission to termination on every build, so an active account reaches that allowance before the per-minute rounding or a compute limit binds

identity_cost.detail: an AWS account is opened with a name, an email address verified by a one-time code, a password and contact information; most new customers are not asked for a payment method to start, though a phone number and a card may be requested for identity verification in some cases

reliability_note: the free tier is stated not to expire after the 12-month AWS Free Tier term; no ban or data-loss event is recorded on the pages read

evidence.quote: The CodeBuild AWS Free Tier includes 100 total build minutes per month with the general1.small or arm1.small instance types using on-demand Amazon EC2.
evidence.proved: the on-demand EC2 free tier is 100 build minutes a month on general1.small or arm1.small

evidence.quote: Using on-demand Lambda, the CodeBuild AWS Free Tier includes 6,000 total build seconds per month with the lambda.arm.1GB or lambda.x86-64.1GB compute types.
evidence.proved: the on-demand Lambda free tier is 6,000 build seconds a month on lambda.arm.1GB or lambda.x86-64.1GB

evidence.quote: The CodeBuild AWS Free Tier does not automatically expire at the end of your 12-month AWS Free Tier term. It is available to new and existing AWS customers.
evidence.proved: the CodeBuild free tier does not expire after the 12-month term and applies to new and existing customers

evidence.quote: Reserved Capacity EC2, Sandbox and Docker image server don't offer an AWS free tier.
evidence.proved: Reserved Capacity, Sandbox and Docker image server have no free allowance

evidence.quote: Build duration is calculated in minutes, from the time you submit your build until your build is terminated, rounded up to the nearest minute.
evidence.proved: on-demand EC2 builds are billed per minute, rounded up from submission to termination

evidence.quote: Build duration is calculated in seconds, from the time you submit your build until your build is terminated, rounded up to the nearest second.
evidence.proved: Lambda builds are billed per second, rounded up from submission to termination

evidence.quote: You can use the AWS CodeBuild console, AWS CLI, or AWS SDKs to run a build in CodeBuild.
evidence.proved: builds run from the console, the AWS CLI or the AWS SDKs

evidence.quote: Enter your name, verify your email with a one-time code, create a password, and provide your contact information.
evidence.proved: the sign-up form asks for a name, an email address verified by a code, a password and contact information

evidence.quote: No credit card is required for most new customers to get started.
evidence.proved: most new customers sign up without a payment method

notes: A managed, AWS-run build service where each build spends minutes or seconds from a monthly allowance. Retention of build logs and artifacts and the price of data transfer out are unverified: no first-party page read states them. An AWS account is the identity gate; CodeBuild free minutes are a usage allowance, not a one-time credit. Reserved Capacity fleets, Sandbox and Docker image server are separate paid offers outside this free allowance and are not documented here.
